errors: Possible redundancy, not an error: over S_0 the graded Frobenius on P'_0⊗O is pF = 0. So ker(F_{M_0}) already provides a canonical complement (the Hodge filtration) to Q'_0⊗O in the ordinary case. The extra datum 'Fil compatible with F_{M_0}' may therefore be uniquely determined, or its compatibility condition needs a precise formulation. This cannot be verified on this illegible page.
Nothing on this page itself can be checked; it seems to duplicate p.24.

ideas.what: Classification of ordinary Barsotti–Tate groups over a smooth base in char p by Dieudonné crystal data (M, ∇, F) with étale/multiplicative filtration and Hodge splitting, with the question of whether this is an equivalence
ideas.modern_name: Dieudonné crystals of ordinary p-divisible groups; full faithfulness of the crystalline Dieudonné functor; Serre–Tate/Katz theory of ordinary groups and F-crystals with unit-root part
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck (BT groups and crystals, ICM 1970 / Montréal 1970); Katz (Serre–Tate local moduli, 1981); Deligne–Illusie; Berthelot–Breen–Messing; de Jong (full faithfulness over smooth bases, 1995)
ideas.where_published: The general question appears in Grothendieck's 'Groupes de Barsotti-Tate et cristaux' (ICM Nice 1970) and the Montréal lectures (1974); the specific ordinary-case category C is unsure.

deep.surprise_reason: The page is an almost illegible faint duplicate or draft of p.24. Its content (Dieudonné classification of ordinary BT groups) is known territory later treated by Katz, Deligne–Illusie and de Jong. Any interest belongs to p.24.
transcription_corrections: The faint text is not unrelated: its structure matches p.24 exactly. The title is probably 'Groupes de Barsotti-Tate ordinaires'.
The symbols read as 'F_i', 'F_ij' are most likely F_{Q'}, F_{P'} and F_M. '( … , F_ij, … )' is probably '(P', Q', M, ∇, F_M, Fil_0)'.
The final displayed formula is likely 'D : BTO(S_0)^o → C', and the closing word may be 'Question' rather than 'Remarque'.
